performance.verdict: CPL spike is intentional throttle, not failure — but 6 overdue milestones now block scale-up.

findings.text: CPL rose 33% to $212.05 against a 28-day baseline of only 8 tracked leads — thin volume makes every missed lead catastrophically expensive.

Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 (overdue 8/31); booking bot battle-test overdue 7/31; Review Boost, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle all overdue 8/31–9/1 — 6 blockers unresolved.
3-day lead signal (9/16–9/18): 1 lead vs prior 3 days (9/13–9/15): 1 lead — flat. Search clicks zeroed out on 9/17–9/18 after averaging 2 clicks/day the prior week.
GBP call rate on Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning is 0.79% and Quality HVAC by Fibid is 0.91% over 28 days — both flagged low vs Quality HVAC Solutions at 2.58%, 27 calls.

GHL shows 982 opportunities created vs 46 won (4.7% win rate) against only 8 tracked ad leads — opportunity count is far outpacing ad-attributed leads, suggesting CRM intake is logging non-ad contacts or duplicates.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL seat assignment — unblocks all budget scale-up per SOW gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake owner role is still unconfirmed as of 9/19 — this is the explicit SOW gate blocking any budget increase. Success check: named owner confirmed in writing with active GHL session by 2026-09-26. No budgets move until this is closed.

suggestions.text: Audit Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning and Quality HVAC by Fibid GBP profiles for missing CTAs — call rate at 0.79% and 0.91% is well below the third profile's 2.58%.
